Universal Developer Orchestrator & Intelligent Observability Engine

Usage: omni <command> [options]

dev           Run all discovered or configured services concurrently with    
              smart failure diagnostics.                                     
doctor        Run a pre-flight health check on host tools (.NET, Node,       
              Python, Docker) & check port availability.                     
analyze       Scan workspace, detect all technology stacks, and print        
              component layout.                                              
init          Create an annotated omni.yaml template in the current          
              directory.                                                     
run <task>    Execute defined pipeline tasks (e.g. build, test) sequentially 
              or in parallel.                                                
--version, -v Display version information.                                   
--help, -h    Display this help message.                                     

Quick Examples: 
  $ omni dev                # Start entire stack concurrently
  $ omni doctor             # Check runtimes and verify no port conflicts
  $ omni run test           # Execute all project test suites
  $ omni init               # Generate custom omni.yaml
